## Hypothesis

The V14E_BEAR_ONLY_GATE candidate is a watcher-only quality gate that excludes the bull v14e branch in the watcher. It does not modify the live engine's entry or exit logic. Therefore, clearing its OP-21 promotion gate (which requires sustained watcher WR ≥55% over N≥100 bear-only observations) has zero impact on the live engine's P&L on J anchor days. The live engine continues to operate with the original v14e logic, resulting in missed J winners and unintended trades on loser days, as evidenced by the Stage-1 baseline run.

## Mechanism

The candidate modifies only `v14_enhanced_watcher.py` by setting `V14E_DIRECTION_FILTER = "bear"` (a watcher-only change per OP-22 engine-benefit note). The live engine (`heartbeat.md`) remains unaffected, as confirmed by the note: "Live engine (heartbeat.md) unaffected â€” watcher-only change." The OP-21 promotion gate for this candidate measures watcher observation quality, not live trading performance. Even if the watcher gate clears, the live engine still takes bull v14e entries (which are detrimental) and misses bearish reversal setups due to unchanged entry criteria.
